documentationSources.title: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable latest supported downloads
evidence: Current download table lists ARM64, X86, and X64 via https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.{architecture}.exe.
The exact latest v14 version is deliberately not listed because it changes frequently; inspect the downloaded installer's File version.
X64 Redistributable contains both ARM64 and X64 binaries; architecture must match the application target.
Latest v14 supports Windows 10 and 11 and Windows Server 2016, 2019, 2022, and 2025.
Redistribution is permitted only for licensed Visual Studio users under applicable Visual Studio license terms.

documentationSources.title: Redistribute Visual C++ files
evidence: Distribution is limited to licensed Visual Studio users and subject to Microsoft Software License Terms.
A newer installed version causes the redistributable to return an error even in quiet mode, so skip if the installed version is newer.

Version is represented by REG_SZ Version and DWORD Major, Minor, Bld, Rbld under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\VisualStudio\14.0\VC\Runtimes\{x86|x64|arm64}; use architecture-appropriate registry view, not an unconditional Wow6432Node prefix.
The applicable Visual Studio license's Distributable Code grant and REDIST list govern redistribution.

documentationSources.title: Microsoft Visual C++ V14 Redistributable and Runtime license terms
evidence: Section 1 permits installation and use of any number of copies.
Section 4(e): You may not share, publish, rent, lease, or otherwise distribute the software or any of its code.

Section 4(f): You may not provide the software as a stand-alone offering or combined with any of your applications for others to use, or transfer the software or these license terms to any third party.
These runtime-use terms do not establish redistribution permission. A separate applicable Visual Studio license grant must be identified and reviewed for this project.

Contains legacy side-by-side D3DX9/10/11,XAudio 2.7,XInput 1.3,XACT,Managed DirectX 1.1; does not replace Windows DirectX; cannot uninstall.

Run dxsetup.exe /silent or DirectSetup; let installer detect components; core DirectX version or individual file presence is insufficient; combine DirectX EULA acceptance before installation; distribution package requires DXSETUP plus dsetup32.dll,dsetup.dll,dxupdate.cab and component CABs.
Windows 10/Server 2016 onward uses OS component source; non-Windows Update sources must match exact OS version.
